_help: Hand-picked features built into an AI agent (nothing to download). Edited by hand; the nightly build does not touch this file. Each item appears on the Skills menu with a 'Built in' badge and its own simple steps.

items.name: advisor
items.summary: Lets Claude ask a second, stronger AI model for advice during long or tricky tasks.
items.use_case: Long, multi-step work where a second opinion saves time: big refactors, a bug that keeps coming back, or checking a plan before Claude commits to it. It adds little on short tasks.
items.description: The advisor lets Claude consult a second, usually stronger model while it works, for example before committing to an approach, when it is stuck on a recurring error, or before declaring a task done. Claude decides when to ask; you only choose which model advises.
items.author: Anthropic

steps.text: Open Claude Code: in a terminal, the desktop app or Remote Control.
Type this, then pick a model from the list:
Or name the model straight away (opus, sonnet or fable):
Work as usual. Claude asks the advisor on its own when a second opinion helps.

notes: The advisor should be as strong as or stronger than the model doing the work — for example Sonnet working with Opus advising.
Advisor use counts toward your Claude plan’s usage limits, or is billed at the advisor model’s rates if you use an API key.
Works when Claude Code connects through Anthropic’s own plans or API (also Claude on AWS and Google Cloud); not through Amazon Bedrock or Microsoft Foundry.
